title: Compare decision backends without inventing missing results
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth compares rules, local model, and System One on a matched ticket. When the decide profile is cold, System One must be marked unavailable — no fake latency or verdict. Related: `nubble_lane_load_hint`, `nubble_model_affinity`. They walk product steps (shadow_decision_backends) and verify completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: `shadow_decision_backends` in `mechaharness.routing` compares backends without inventing unavailable results. `CliInstrumentor` verb `shadow_decision_backends` exposes the diagnostic.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `shadow_backends.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
